say: Mata da yawa suna raina abin da suke yi. Misali, Mercy ta sayar da kayan abinci a wata kasuwa a Ibadan tsawon shekaru takwas, kuma ta kasance ma’ajin kungiyar mata har tsawon shekaru uku. Shafukan ta na LinkedIn babu kowa.

panel.heading: Aiki na yau da kullun na Mercy, wanda aka bayyana
right: Masu daukar ma'aikata NGO ne suka samo su

say: Yanzu shigarta ta farko tana karanta Mai gida, tanadar Mercy, tare da abokan ciniki kusan 150 na yau da kullun. Ta biyu ta karanta Treasurer, tana yin rikodin gudunmawa ga mambobi 40 a cikin Google Sheets.
Wata mai daukar ma'aikata ta NGO da ke neman rikodi a Ibadan ta iya samun ta.

say: Imel ɗin ku na iya sake saita duk sauran kalmomin shiga, don haka yana buƙatar mafi ƙarfi: dogon kalmar wucewa da ba ku yi amfani da ita ba.

panel.heading: Kulle asusunku kuma kuyi sauri

cards.d: Dogon kalmar wucewa, daban don imel ɗin ku. Kada sunan ku, ranar haihuwa ko 123456.
Kunna shi a shafin Tsaro na Asusun Google. Ajiye lambobin ajiya akan takarda a gida.
Kira lambar aikin bankin ku a lokaci guda. Canja kalmar wucewa ta imel kuma fita da sauran zama.

say: Kunna Tabbatar da Mataki 2 a cikin Tsaro shafin na Google Account. Sannan mai laifi ba zai iya shiga ba tare da wayarka ba, koda da kalmar sirri. Saita PIN ɗin WhatsApp kuma.

Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
